text:
alina: Thought: mini food-truck crawl + 30-min photo scavenger hunt this Saturday noon? 3 trucks within a 10-min walk, small prize for the best photo set. Low-pressure, pay-as-you-go. Who's down? :truck: :camera_with_flash:

marco: Love it. I'm in if we start ~12:15 so folks can get there from brunch. I can bring a cheap instant camera for goofy pics. :grin:

sophie: Count me in. Any veg/halal options at the trucks?

owen: Theres a kebab truck and a vegan taco truck last market weekend. Both were great. Also happy to be photo judge.

tasha: Are we doing a prize? small snack voucher? :thinking_face:

alina: Thinking $10 snack voucher for winner + a silly trophy (tiny foam camera). I'll check People Ops. If stipend can't be approved, we'll do a $5 split or no prize.

ops-bot: Reminder: team socials under $15/person can be expensed under "team-social" at https://redwood.internal/expenses. Submit receipts and attendee list. Approval ~24-48h.

marco: Quick poll via reactions: :one: = Sat 12:15, :two: = Sat 1pm, :x: = can't make it. React below.

sophie: :one:

owen: :one:

tasha: :two:

ryan-remote: :house: remote but would love to join the photo thread live and vote. happy to be remote judge if needed.

alina: Looks like 12:15 wins. I'll make a calendar event and pin meeting spot (front of office). Rules: take 3 photos from a short prompt list I'll post (e.g., most colorful plate, best candid, weirdest condiment) within 45 minutes. Post to this thread with captions. Low-key, creative.

marco: I'll print little prompt cards and bring some disposable cameras for anyone who wants analog vibes. Also bringing backup phone charger.

sophie: If Ops okays voucher, can we reserve one for the winner? otherwise i'll donate a $10 lunch gift card.

ops-bot: If you plan to expense a voucher, attach the vendor receipt and attendee list in the submission. Tag #lunch-plans for faster routing.

owen: remote folks: we'll create a dedicated thread for photos so you can drop pics and vote. Good to include ry

ryan-remote: Thanks! I'll set a reminder to jump into the photo thread around 12:45 and vote. Also happy to livestream a quick pano if you want a remote group selfie. :camera_flash:

alina: Amazing. I'll post the prompt list and pin meetup details. Low-pressure, fun, 60 minutes max. See y'all Sat 12:15 (front steps). Tag anyone else who loves food + dumb photos. :sparkles:
